TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.TITLE: AI Agent Assistant
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DESCRIPTION: Builds an AI Agent's Training and checks that the engine will actually be able to run it before you save.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.UNSUPPORTED_HINT: There are saved sources the assistant doesn't know how to offer and won't use:
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.PHRASES_HINT: Verbatim, typos and all. Each topic's description is written in these words, so the agent recognises real messages rather than manual language.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.PHRASES_EMPTY: No customer messages yet to use as a reference.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.EMPTY_ACCOUNT_TITLE: This account has nothing to build an agent from yet.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.EMPTY_ACCOUNT_HINT: You need at least one Knowledge Base source or one case type. Without that, the assistant has nothing to propose from and could only offer generic templates.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.ERROR_FORBIDDEN: Only an administrator can use the AI Agent Assistant.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.ERROR_GENERIC: Couldn't read what this account has. Please try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.REPORT_EMPTY: Once there's a Training written, you'll see here what the engine recognises.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRAFT_PLACEHOLDER: The assistant writes it, and you can edit it by hand: it's checked as you type.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.INPUT_PLACEHOLDER: Tell it what you want the agent to do…
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.THINKING_EDIT: Editing the Training. A long one can take a couple of minutes: it comes back whole and is checked before it is shown.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.CHANGE_UNDECLARED_HINT: This changed and the assistant did not mention it. Check it in the Training.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.CHANGE_UNDECLARED: {count} change(s) the assistant did not mention, highlighted in amber. Check them before saving.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.REJECTED_HINT: The change left it unable to run ({count} blocking issue(s)), and the one you had runs. The proposal was not applied.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.MANUAL_BADGE_HINT: You changed the Training since the assistant's last delivery. The next message tells it which parts are yours so it leaves them alone.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.MANUAL_CONFLICT_HINT: The assistant changed {keys} without being asked. The rest of its change was applied, and those parts keep your version.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.VERSIONS_EMPTY: No versions yet. One is saved each time the assistant delivers the Training and each time you change it by hand before sending a message.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.VERSIONS_ERROR: That version could not be loaded. Try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.VERSION_RESTORED: Version %{number} restored. What you had is saved as a version with the next message.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.VERSION_DIFF_STATS: To reach the current one: %{added} line(s) added, %{removed} removed.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.VERSION_DIFF_SAME: Same as what is in the editor now.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.STAGE_WRITING_EDIT: Editing the Training… a long one can take about a minute.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.STAGE_MODE_CHECK: It still needs to know whether it answers or hands off: asking…
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.STAGE_EDIT_REPAIR: It changed parts you did not ask for: asking it to put them back…
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.STAGE_REPAIRING: Fixing what the checker flagged (round %{round} of %{of})…
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.STAGE_ROUTING: Testing that each branch picks itself…
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SAVE_REPLACE_HINT: A copy of the previous Training is kept, in case you need to go back.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.ERROR_NO_KEY: This account has no OpenAI integration configured, so the assistant can't write.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.AUDIT_HINT: Every saved agent, run through the same checker. \u201cConversational\u201d is not a defect: it's an agent with no declared topics, answering with the model alone.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SAVE_NAME_TAKEN: An AI Agent with that name already exists in this account. Pick another one.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SAVE_CONTEXT_HINT: Business facts you mentioned in the conversation. Empty is fine: the assistant doesn't fill in what you didn't tell it, because the agent would quote it as true.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SAVE_FROM_TEMPLATE: This Training came from “%{name}”. Saving replaces its own and keeps a copy of the previous one.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SESSIONS_HINT: A good Training rarely comes out in one sitting. These are the conversations of every administrator in the account: you can go back to one, finished or half-done, and continue it.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_HINT: Write a question the way a customer would. You will see which topic it falls into, which source it searches and what it finds. No message is sent and no case is opened.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_PLACEHOLDER: I can't log into the system since yesterday
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_FAILED: The test could not be run. Try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_ROUTE_NONE_DECLARED: the Training declares no topics — everything falls to the conversational path
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_ROUTE_UNMATCHED: none, and no default topic is declared
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_ROUTE_IS_DEFAULT: Careful: this is also the default topic, so a question the classifier does not recognise lands here too. Try another wording to confirm it was really chosen.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_NO_SOURCE: This topic consults no source: it answers with the model only.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_UNREADABLE: The engine does not recognise that source, so this topic will not consult anything.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_SOURCE_MISSING: That source does not exist in the account or is inactive. The engine will find nothing.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_LIVE_SOURCE: This source is queried live against an external service, so it is not run in the test. The topic, the label and the case are the real ones.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_EMBEDDING_FAILED: The question could not be vectorised. Check the OpenAI integration.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_NO_MATCH: The source returns nothing for this question. In a real conversation the agent would fall back to the conversational path.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_UNSUPPORTED_MODE: This source cannot be dry-run yet.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_TAG_NONE: none — automations that depend on a label will not run
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_CASE_AFTER: yes, if the source does not resolve the turn
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_CASE_TYPE_MISSING: Type «%{name}» does not exist in the account: the case would be opened with whichever type the intake infers, not that one.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_CASE_INHERITED: This topic declares no escalation of its own, so it inherits the loose @crear_ticket from the Training — and it runs before the source.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_FOOTER: The topic was classified by %{model}. No message was sent.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.REPORT_GOTO: Jump to that line of the Training
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.RESOURCES_HINT: What the account has to build an agent with. Tap any piece to copy it: that is exactly how it is written in the Training.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SOURCES_HINT: Where a branch searches when a question comes in.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SOURCES_EMPTY: No sources loaded. With no source, every branch answers with the model alone.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.GROUPS_HINT: Slices of the corpus, by response name prefix. They keep two branches of the same agent from overlapping.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.GROUPS_EMPTY: No groups. With no group, the branch searches every response.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.CASE_TYPES_HINT: Which type a branch opens the case with when it escalates.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.LABELS_HINT: What each branch closes the turn with. This is what triggers automations.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.COPY_FAILED: The browser would not allow copying. Select it by hand.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.ACTIONS_HINT: What a branch DOES when it escalates, on the right of the arrow. To open a case use @crear_ticket(tipo=…) above: with no type, the case opens with whichever the intake infers.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.PICK_OTHER_HINT: Tap here and type which one in the box below
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_EMPTY: You have not tested a question yet. Write one below, the way a customer would.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRY_RUN_STALE: The Training changed after this test: it no longer describes the current text.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.TESTS_HINT: Customer messages written by the assistant for each branch, run through the engine's real classifier. A ✗ is a message that lands on another branch.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.TESTS_SUMMARY: %{passed} of %{total} landed on their branch · %{edge} edge case(s) for you to review
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.TESTS_STALE: The Training changed after these tests: test again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.TESTS_FROM_DESCRIPTIONS: New messages could not be written: the phrases from each description were used.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.TESTS_ERROR: The tests could not run. Try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.OPTIMIZE_HINT: The assistant looks for repeated rules, contradictions and text that can be said in fewer words, and proposes a version. It does not change routing or remove sections, and nothing is applied until you decide.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.OPTIMIZE_RUNNING: Analyzing the Training… a long one takes about a minute.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.OPTIMIZE_STALE: The Training changed after it was analyzed: applying would overwrite those changes. Analyze again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.OPTIMIZE_DISCARDED_WORSE: The proposal left the Training with problems it does not have today, so it was discarded. The findings still apply.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.OPTIMIZE_LOST_HINT: These rules do not appear anywhere in the proposal, even if the assistant marked them as repeated. Checked rule by rule.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.OPTIMIZE_RESTORED: The proposal touched parts that optimizing cannot change, and they were put back: %{keys}
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.OPTIMIZE_ROUTING_NOTE: Branches do not change, so routing is the same. What changes is how the agent answers: try it in the test bench before saving.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.OPTIMIZE_APPLIED: Optimization applied in the editor. It is not saved yet.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.OPTIMIZE_ERROR: The Training could not be analyzed. Try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.EXPLAIN_ROUTE: Branch %{name} · label %{tag} · looks up %{source} · if unresolved: %{escalation}
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.EXPLAIN_LOOSE: %{directive} is written in the prose: the engine does not run it from here, only inside a @ruta line.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.EXPLAIN_INTERPRETATION_HINT: This is its interpretation of the text, not a verification.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.EXPLAIN_ERROR: That fragment could not be explained. Try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.INBOX_HINT: Everything is tested with this inbox: routing, suggested tests and the test bench. If it is not the inbox the agent will work in, results may not match production.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DICTATE_HINT: Dictate: record what you want to say and it is written in the box so you can review it before sending
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DICTATE_EMPTY: Nothing could be understood in the recording. Try again closer to the microphone.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DICTATE_ERROR: The audio could not be turned into text. Try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DICTATE_ERROR_NO_API_KEY: Dictation needs the account's OpenAI integration.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DICTATE_ERROR_TOO_LARGE: The recording is too long. Dictate it in parts.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DICTATE_ERROR_NO_AUDIO: No audio arrived. Check that the browser has microphone permission.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.TREE_ROUTES_EMPTY: No routes: the agent handles everything conversationally, without looking anything up.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.TREE_SECTIONS_EMPTY: No sections: the agent has no written instructions.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DEFINITION_HINT: This is not part of the Training: it is stored in the AI Agent when you click "Save to an AI Agent".
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DEFINITION_OBJECTIVE_HINT: what the agent is for, in one sentence
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DEFINITION_CONTEXT_HINT: business facts the agent may quote: hours, versions, policies…
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DEFINITION_CONTEXT_WARNING: The agent quotes this as fact: only put in what you know is true.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DEFINITION_FIX_ERROR: The text could not be corrected. Try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.FIX_PROTECTED: The correction changed something that must not change (%{items}): the text was left as it was.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_HINT: Upload a .md with the initial instructions: who the agent is, what it handles, what it never does. The assistant reads them, shows what it understood and what's missing, and writes the Training.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_CAN_CLOSE: You can close this window: reading continues and you'll see it when you reopen. One-page instructions take seconds; very long ones, several minutes.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_FAILED: The instructions could not be fully read. What was read is saved: retrying won't charge it again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_MODO_RESPONDE: Answers, and escalates if it can't solve
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_MODO_DERIVA: Always hands off: collects the data and passes the case
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_GAP_MODO: Whether it answers or always hands off
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_GAP_FUENTE_O_ESCALAMIENTO: Where the answer comes from or what happens if it can't solve
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ERROR: The instructions could not be uploaded. Try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ERROR_BAD_EXTENSION: It must be a .md, .markdown or .txt file.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ERROR_NOT_TEXT: The file isn't text (a renamed Word file?). Save it as .md or .txt.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_GAP_CONTRADICCION: The instructions contradict each other; which one applies?
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ASK_CONTRADICCION: The instructions contradict each other about «%{sobre}». Which one applies?
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ASK_MODO: Does the agent answer, or always hand off?
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ASK_FRASES: How does the customer write when they want «%{tema}»?
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ASK_FRASES_HINT: One phrase per line, as the customer would write it
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ASK_FUENTES: For «%{tema}», where does the answer come from or what happens if it can't solve it?
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ASK_FUENTES_HINT: For example: the price sheet, open a case, hand off to a person
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ASK_ETIQUETAS_HINT: Pick one from the account or type a new one
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ASK_EMPTY_HINT: Anything left blank will be marked as pending in the Training to complete later.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_WRITING: Writing the Training… it can take about a minute.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_WRITE_ERROR: The Training could not be written. Try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_REPLACES_DRAFT: This replaces what you currently have in the Agent Structure.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_COVERED: I added %{count} points from the instructions that the draft had left out.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_ASK_NOTHING: Nothing is missing: the instructions have everything needed. You can create the Training now.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_CHAT_USER: 📎 Create the Training from the instructions «%{name}»
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.BRIEF_CHAT_INVITE: Want to change anything? Tell me here: for example «add that no appointments are booked on Sundays» or «a more formal tone».
